column1: # pgvector TAP tests that pgrust fails by design, each pinned to the exact checks that fail. run-tap.sh reads this in
# pgrust mode only: the C reference must pass every test. A row holds only while prove reports exactly these failed
# checks and the test runs to its end; one check more or fewer, or a test that dies, fails the tier. run-all.sh lists
# every accepted row in its report. Add a row only on the user's decision.
